sentences.zh: 密苏里河水位达到有记录以来的第三高洪水位。

sentences.en: The Missouri River's floodwaters.
sentences.zh: 密苏里河的洪水。

sentences.en: People are suffering.
sentences.zh: 人们在受苦。

sentences.en: People are dying.
sentences.zh: 人们在死去。

sentences.en: Entire ecosystems are collapsing.
sentences.zh: 整个生态系统正在崩溃。

sentences.en: We are in the beginning of a mass extinction.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于第六次大灭绝的开端。

sentences.en: And all you can talk about is money and fairy tales of eternal economic growth.
sentences.zh: 而你们满脑子谈论的只有金钱和永恒经济增长的神话。

sentences.en: How dare you?
sentences.zh: 怎么敢的？

sentences.en: In Hong Kong, protests continue.
sentences.zh: 在香港，抗议活动仍在继续。

sentences.en: They've been going.
sentences.zh: 它们一直在进行。

sentences.en: The 10th week in Chile after violent protests.
sentences.zh: 智利发生暴力抗议后的第十周。

sentences.en: Bolivia's political unrest turned deadly.
sentences.zh: 玻利维亚的政治动荡已造成人员死亡。

sentences.en: ...by road in Lebanon for a third day.
sentences.zh: ……黎巴嫩的道路封锁进入第三天。

sentences.en: Iranians have taken to the streets by thousands.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的伊朗人走上街头。

sentences.en: ...protesting across Egypt, calling on president.
sentences.zh: ……在埃及各地抗议，呼吁总统下台。

sentences.en: ...translates against the controversies of Ecuador to protest the president.
sentences.zh: ……抗议厄瓜多尔的争议事件，矛头直指总统。

sentences.en: Algeria has been rocked by...
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚正受到……的震撼

sentences.en: Across the world in dozens of countries, protesters have taken to the streets.
sentences.zh: 在世界各地数十个国家，抗议者纷纷走上街头。

sentences.en: Demonstrators are united in frustration with economic disparity and unrealized economic expectations.
sentences.zh: 示威者因对经济差距和未实现的经济预期感到失望而团结在一起。

sentences.en: Dear Ellie and James, this is a moment that you will read about in your history books.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的艾莉和詹姆斯，这是你们将在历史书中读到的一刻。

sentences.en: Today, I will vote to impeach the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 今天，我将投票弹劾美利坚合众国总统。

sentences.en: I believe this is the most unfair, politically biased, rigged process that I have seen in my entire life.
sentences.zh: 我相信这是我一生中见过最不公平、充满政治偏见且被操纵的程序。

sentences.en: If a president undermining our national security and using the federal government for his own selfish personal gain
sentences.zh: 如果一个总统破坏我们的国家安全，并为了他自私的个人利益而动用联邦政府

sentences.en: is not impeachable conduct, then, Madam Speaker, I don't know what is.
sentences.zh: 这如果都不算构成弹劾的罪行，那么，议长女士，我不知道什么才是。

sentences.en: I believe that Democrats are tearing this country apart.
sentences.zh: 我相信民主党人正在把这个国家撕裂。

sentences.en: They're tearing families apart.
sentences.zh: 他们正在撕裂家庭。

sentences.en: President Trump's behavior is exactly what our founders feared moSt.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统的行为正是我们的建国先辈们最害怕的。

sentences.en: They knew that with the awesome power of the presidency came the risk of a president abusing that power for personal gain.
sentences.zh: 他们知道，总统职位的巨大权力伴随着总统为个人利益滥用这种权力的风险。

sentences.en: This day is about one thing and one thing only.
sentences.zh: 今天这一天只关乎一件事，而且仅此一件事。

sentences.en: They hate this president.
sentences.zh: 他们痛恨这位总统。

sentences.en: This is about protecting the future of our nation and our democracy from corruption, abuse of power, criminal cover-ups, and bribery.
sentences.zh: 这是为了保护我们国家的未来和我们的民主，免受腐败、滥用权力、掩盖犯罪和贿赂的侵害。

sentences.en: It's a sham, a witch hunt, and it's tantamount to a coup.
sentences.zh: 这是一场骗局、一场政治迫害，等同于一场政变。

sentences.en: With that, Madam Speaker, I yield.
sentences.zh: 有鉴于此，议长女士，我发言完毕。

sentences.en: Our time for general debate has expired.
sentences.zh: 我们进行一般性辩论的时间已到。

sentences.en: The question now occurs on the adoption of Article 1.
sentences.zh: 现在对采纳第一条款进行表决。

sentences.en: All in favor, say aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成的请说“赞成”。

sentences.en: Aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成。

sentences.en: Opposed, no.
sentences.zh: 反对的请说“反对”。

sentences.en: Oh, I think we have a vote coming in.
sentences.zh: 哦，我想我们有投票结果要出来了。

sentences.en: The yeas are 230.
sentences.zh: 赞成票为230票。

sentences.en: The nays are 197.
sentences.zh: 反对票为197票。

sentences.en: Present is one.
sentences.zh: 出席票为1票。

sentences.en: Article 1 is adopted.
sentences.zh: 第一条款通过。

sentences.en: So we got every single Republican voted for us.
sentences.zh: 所以我们得到了每一位共和党人的投票支持。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: The question is on adoption of Article 2.
sentences.zh: 现在对采纳第二条款进行表决。

sentences.en: On this vote, the yeas are 229.
sentences.zh: 在这次投票中，赞成票为229票。

sentences.en: The nays are 198.
sentences.zh: 反对票为198票。

sentences.en: Present is one.
sentences.zh: 出席票为1票。

sentences.en: Article 2 is adopted.
sentences.zh: 第二条款通过。

sentences.en: This lawless partisan impeachment is a political suicide march for the Democrat Party.
sentences.zh: 这场无法无天的党派弹劾是民主党人的政治自杀进行曲。

sentences.en: Have you seen my polls in the last four weeks?
sentences.zh: 你看过我过去四周的民调数据吗？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Will President Donald Trump be convicted and removed from office for high crimes and misdemeanors in the coming Senate trial?
sentences.zh: 在即将到来的参议院审判中，唐纳德·特朗普总统会因严重罪行和失职而被定罪并罢免吗？

sentences.en: Or will he be acquitted and become the first president in modern American history to stand for reelection, having been impeached by the House of Representatives?
sentences.zh: 还是他会被宣告无罪，成为美国现代史上第一位在被众议院弹劾后竞选连任的总统？

sentences.en: From what we know about Donald Trump's call with the Ukrainian president, what's on the calls with other world leaders?
sentences.zh: 从我们对唐纳德·特朗普与乌克兰总统通话的了解来看，与其他世界领导人的通话内容是什么？

sentences.en: In 2019, we saw climate change become a crisis in the daily lives of many more people who did not expect it.
sentences.zh: 在2019年，我们看到气候变化成为更多原本意想不到的人日常生活中的一场危机。

sentences.en: What will that look like in 2020?
sentences.zh: 2020年情况会怎样？

sentences.en: In just the past year, Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg was treated for both lung and pancreatic cancer.
sentences.zh: 就在过去的一年里，最高法院大法官鲁斯·巴德·金斯伯格接受了肺癌和胰腺癌的治疗。

sentences.en: Will she still be on the Supreme Court at the end of President Trump's first term?
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统第一任期结束时，她还会留在最高法院吗？

sentences.en: How are these major changes in American immigration policy going to start rippling throughout the rest of the world?
sentences.zh: 美国移民政策的这些重大变化将如何开始对世界其他地区产生连锁反应？

sentences.en: Will global nationalism continue to sweep the globe or will we see it begin to reach its nadir?
sentences.zh: 全球民族主义会继续席卷全球，还是我们会看到它开始走向低谷？

sentences.en: How will the Democratic Party resolve the battle between moderates and progressives?
sentences.zh: 民主党将如何解决温和派与进步派之间的争斗？

sentences.en: Will 2020 be the year that I finally become a TikTok star?
sentences.zh: 2020年会是我最终成为TikTok明星的一年吗？

sentences.en: When will international regulators clear Boeing 737 Max and will people actually fly on it?
sentences.zh: 国际监管机构何时会批准波音737 MAX复飞，人们真的会坐它吗？

sentences.en: Will Democrats suffer in 2020 because they impeached President Trump?
sentences.zh: 民主党会因为弹而在2020年失利吗？

sentences.en: Do any of the candidates have a strategy to deal with China and to deal with its rise in the 21st century?
sentences.zh: 候选人中有人有应对中国及其在21世纪崛起的战略吗？

sentences.en: How will the Me Too movement play out in the presidential race?
sentences.zh: “我也是”运动将在总统竞选中如何发挥作用？

sentences.en: Will a fractious group of Democrats, who are unified only in their agreement that President Trump must go, manage to bridge the divide between the left and the middle
sentences.zh: 一盘散沙的民主党人，他们唯一的共识就是必须赶走特朗普总统，他们能否设法弥合左翼和中间派的分歧

sentences.en: and come up with a strategy that will not strike such fear in the hearts of American voters that they don't simply stick with what they've got?
sentences.zh: 并提出一个不会让美国选民内心感到如此恐惧、以至于干脆维持现状的战略？

sentences.en: People around me and folks in the media have said we have never been this divided.
sentences.zh: 我身边的人和媒体朋友都说我们从来没有像现在这样分裂过。

sentences.en: So in this moment, are we more divided than at any other time in American history?
sentences.zh: 所以在此时此刻，我们是否比美国历史上任何其他时期都更加分裂？

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: For the rest of the week, we'll revisit our favorite episodes of the year, listen back, and then hear what's happened since the stories first ran.
sentences.zh: 在本周剩下的时间里，我们将重温我们今年最喜欢的剧集，回顾并听取这些故事首次播出后的最新进展。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正准备迎接假期的到来。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物禁忌吗？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何地方查找《Wirecutter秀》。
